headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Justin Sterner (Athletics) was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right knee chondromalacia. Tyler Soderstrom (Athletics) was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 15, 2026, with left hip impingement. Masataka Yoshida (Boston Red Sox) was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain, while Justin Slaten (Boston Red Sox) was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The St. Louis Cardinals made a notable trade, acquiring Harold Rivas (Baltimore Orioles) from the Boston Red Sox in a player-to-be-named-later deal. Additionally, the Milwaukee Brewers acquired Jonathan Ornelas (Athletics) in a trade for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them a decisive loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a strong performance, collecting 3 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Rout Rays 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a lopsided 10-2 victory. Jackson Holliday, Colton Cowser, Ryan Vilade, and Chandler Simpson led the Orioles' offense with strong performances.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 3-5 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with standout performances from Matt Olson and Austin Riley. Gabriel Moreno and Ildemaro Vargas led the Diamondbacks' offense, while James McCann contributed to the effort.

top_news.title: **Athletics Update Justin Sterner to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added infield depth with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
